decisions.reason: Correctly pins the sole crash to plugin A's line-24 useSessionPendingInteraction call, explains alpha.2 dropped the prop in favor of useSessionStatus while useSessions remains, and B uses no standard-kit hooks.

Explains the per-slot shared DrawerErrorBoundary unmounting the whole input.dock list on a child throw, cites the console fallback line, and attributes the attach button's survival to the separate input.left boundary.

Disabling A proves crash-coupling and B can render once freed; explicitly notes it does not certify B on alpha.2 nor exclude silent dock defects; reinstalling B is useless and the both-plugins theory is refuted.

Code selects the pending hook the host supplies (useSessionStatus preferred), falls back to an empty map so only the pending indicator degrades while running/todos/token/ETA persist, and justifies silent degradation via the shared-boundary co-tenant outage.

Rebuild client bundle + hard refresh without host restart, both entries mounted, B regression covers paste/remove/target-following with A enabled; tenant feature-detection, own-boundary wrapping, and per-entry boundary trade-offs are covered.

caps.reason: Final remedy fixes plugin A only; the A2-01 B check is a hypothetical verification item, not an assertion of two independent breakages.
